{{Top|leg}}
A '''security override device''' was a tool designed to bypass [[security lock]]s such as those aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Denuab Venithon]] made use of a security override device when capturing [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] with his brother, [[Dorin Venithon]].
